summary:
## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so paid customers do not receive dunning reminders. The router split is paused/superseded by this higher-priority bug. Later resume the pending rename, Twilio retry, and release work.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Current account function: `fetch_account`; `get_user_record` is superseded.
- Sandbox payments API: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is shut down and superseded.
- Release tag: `rename-fetch-account-v1`.
- Twilio maximum attempts: 2; metric label exactly `sms:delivery_attempt`.
- CLI parsed currency field: `args.currency`; obsolete `args.filters["currency"]` is superseded.
- Shared parser helper: `_add_billing_filters(parser)`; includes `dest="currency"`.
- Currency utility: `billing/currency.py`, `round_money(amount, places=2)`.
- After changing `requirements/base.txt`, run `make license-check` from repository root.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Increasing SQLAlchemy pool size to 50 caused staging contention/deadlocks.
- Changing legacy invoice rounding is unrelated to current work.
- Clearing events before `record_usage_event()` loses retryable failures.
- Reusing incoming `usage_batch` lists caused shared-state aliasing.
- Retaining completed events in `_last_batch` caused unbounded memory growth.
- Router splitting is paused, not abandoned.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Validate billing-worker fix: worker suite passed 41 tests; full suite passed 118 tests, 7 skipped; 5,000-batch memory repro peaked at 7.3 MiB.
- [done] Deduplicate CLI billing filters; focused suites passed 37 tests; Ruff and `git diff --check` passed.
- [done] Add `test_billing_filter_abbreviations_parse`; its test result is status unknown.
- [pending] Inspect and fix paid-customer suppression in dunning scheduler.
- [pending] Add/execute scheduler regression tests; exact next command: `pytest tests/dunning -q`.
- [pending] Resume remaining rename call sites, route split, Twilio retries, tagging, and pushing.
- [pending] Run `git tag -f rename-fetch-account-v1 HEAD`, then `git push --force-with-lease origin refs/tags/rename-fetch-account-v1`.

## Recent work
CLI invoice filters were consolidated, currency parsing corrected, duplicate options removed, and abbreviation behavior regression-tested. The operator then paused router work to prioritize a newly discovered dunning scheduler defect; no scheduler investigation or fix has yet been performed.
